description: This file defines a subclass of FragmentActivity that sets up a tabbed interface for demonstrating notification features, including a ViewPager with three fragments: HeadsUpNotificationFragment, VisibilityMetadataFragment, and OtherMetadataFragment.

classes.name: LNotificationActivity
classes.description: Main activity that hosts a tabbed interface for notification sample fragments.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and configures tabbed fragments.

classes.name: NotificationsPagerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for managing the fragments displayed within the ViewPager.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the fragment for a given tab position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tabs (3).

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Provides the title for each tab.
